name: Sarkuysan Elektrolitik Bakir Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Sarkuysan Elektrolitik Bakir Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S., together with its subsidiaries, produces and trades in electrolytic copper wires, copper pipes, coppering, and copper alloys in Turkey. It offers electrolytic copper cathode products; oxygen free and ETP wire rods; DHP and ETP copper billets; bare, tin plated, and nickel-plated copper single wires; bare and tin plated, and nickel plated multi wires, as well as bare and tin plated multi wires on braider bobbins; and bare, tin plated, and nickel plated bunched conductors. The company also provides flat wires and profiles, and PV ribbon wires; copper and copper alloy contact wires, and stranded copper and copper alloy conductors; copper tubes…
